_about: Retrieval eval. 'lookup': which opinion a question is about (document-level). 'facts': the passage containing a specific fact must be retrieved (evidence string must appear in a retrieved chunk of that document). 'multi': every listed case's evidence must be retrieved. Questions were drafted with an AI assistant; evidence strings are checked against the indexed text by run_rag_eval.py.
